# Discover ELC Schools' winning approach for IELTS exam preparation

Prepare for IELTS success with ELC Schools. Expert tutors, flexible courses, and supportive learning environments in Brighton, Eastbourne, and Chester.
...
That’s why it’s so important to prepare properly. ELC Schools is the ideal partner to help you reach your goal, with expert-led courses designed to build your confidence and boost your score.

## Why choose ELC Schools for IELTS preparation?

ELC schools jointly have the right to call themselves the UK’s top-ranking group of English Language Schools, according to The British Council’s Accreditation UK scheme.

But I wanted to know how this no.1 position translates into the best experience for someone thinking about taking an IELTS preparation course in the UK. To find out what makes ELC’s IELTS programme so effective, I spoke with Simon Cummings, Assistant Academic Manager at ELC Brighton. Simon has worked with ELC since the 1990s and returned in 2008 after teaching in Spain, Croatia, Thailand, Germany, and the UAE. With over 30 years of experience and a deep understanding of the IELTS exam, Simon offered expert insights into what sets ELC apart.

“Our IELTS teachers are not just experienced - they’re exam-focused,” Simon explained. “Some have worked as IELTS examiners, so they bring a really clear sense of what examiners look for, especially in speaking and writing. That helps students prepare more precisely.”

Another key strength is ELC’s honest and flexible approach. Before students even arrive, their speaking and writing levels are assessed to estimate their current IELTS band. This allows ELC to make personalised recommendations. “If they’re not ready for IELTS yet, we’ll suggest starting with General English,” said Simon. “It’s better to build their overall level first and then tackle the exam.”

ELC courses are designed to be intensive but manageable. Classes typically have 6 to 8 students, with a maximum of 12, and each week includes 25 lessons of 45 minutes. That’s just under 80 hours over four weeks. “We usually see a half-band improvement in that time, and motivated students can even go up a whole band,” Simon said. Students also receive one-to-one tutorials every four weeks, where teachers review progress, revisit feedback, and help with goal setting. “We make sure students understand what they need to do, and how much effort it will take,” Simon added.

## At the end of the day, you’re still the main reason for your IELTS success

It’s great that ELC schools are the leading group in the UK. This means that each ELC school is very well organised and things like quality assurance are second-to-none. That possibly means the school attracts students who are serious about learning and progression, and they are looking for the best. But I guess there is also a risk that some students might come here because they hope the top quality, super-experienced staff are going to somehow do more of the work.

A word of caution. It’s great to have some of the best teachers in the world, who have been doing this job a long time, and who can tune into what you’re like, how you tick, what approaches might best help you and what your language strengths and weaknesses might be.

But at the end of the day, you are the one taking the exam. You’re the one deciding how much time you’re going to spend practising the new language you encounter, working through exercises you’ve been recommended, and planning your time carefully to work on IELTS preparation outside the classroom, whilst leaving enough spare time to really enjoy yourself in the UK. That takes commitment, persistence, and endurance, and your ability to juggle your time well and stay motivated is really what will make the biggest difference.

Simon summed it up simply: “IELTS hasn’t changed much since 2005, but student effort makes all the difference. We provide the guidance, but students have to put in the work. When they do, the results speak for themselves.”

Full disclosure: IELTSbiz is our own platform and appears as the recommended companion at the end. Road to IELTS is described strengths-first - and an official product from the test's co-owner earns a degree of trust no third party can claim.

## What is Road to IELTS?

Road to IELTS is the British Council's most popular online preparation course, developed with ClarityEnglish. ClarityEnglish lists over 300 interactive activities, 17 advice and tutorial videos, 40 practice tests and an IELTS-on-computer simulator, across all four skills for both Academic and General Training, with a free version to try (as of September 2026).

Distribution is the unusual part, and it changed in 2026. The British Council's Road to IELTS page now presents IELTS Ready.

The free tier, open to anyone with an account, includes a 50-minute Mini Mock Test with AI feedback and an estimated band, two full IELTS mock tests with feedback and model answers, short guided preparation modules, and podcasts and webinars.

IELTS Ready Premium, free when you book with the British Council, adds 40 full practice tests with scores and model answers (plus optional AI feedback), a 25-minute Express Mock Test with AI feedback across all four skills, self-study courses, live and on-demand webinars, question-type practice and a personalised dashboard.

Some regional British Council pages still describe an earlier six-test Member package and a "worth US$170" Premium value, so check your local page. Institutions buy Road to IELTS from ClarityEnglish on request.

## Who is Road to IELTS for?

Candidates who have booked (or will book) with the British Council, first and foremost - for them it is effectively free official prep, and turning it down makes little sense. It also suits candidates who value provenance: every activity reflects the test maker's own question style, so nothing you practise will be off-format.

It is less suited to being your complete preparation if you are chasing a specific band jump. Structured content plus right/wrong marking gets you familiar; it does not tell you why the same question types keep beating you.

## Road to IELTS features

### Interactive activities

The core 300+ activities: interactive exercises per skill and question type, marked automatically. The format familiarity is the value - matching headings behave like real matching headings, because the same organisation wrote both.

### Advice videos and tips

Videos from British Council experts explain each section and question type, with practical tips of the kind the test maker is uniquely positioned to give. The teaching is measured and reliable rather than charismatic - closer to official documentation than to a star tutor.

### Practice tests

ClarityEnglish lists 40 practice tests plus an IELTS-on-computer simulator - useful now that paper-based IELTS has ended in most markets (the last paper tests ran on 27 June 2026). Through IELTS Ready Premium, British Council bookers get 40 full practice tests with scores and model answers.

### The e-books and extras

Depending on version and market, downloadable support materials round out the package.

The Premium version — free once you book your test with British Council — adds full practice tests and a structured pathway. Verdict: there is no reason to pay anyone before you have exhausted this.

### IDP IELTS Prepare — best for free live masterclasses

IDP, the other co-owner, runs free masterclasses and webinars alongside its practice materials, and its familiarisation content is especially useful for the computer-delivered test interface. If you are booking through IDP — the common route in Vietnam, India, and Bangladesh — start here. Verdict: use it in parallel with IELTS Ready; they are complementary, not rivals.

### E2 Test Prep — best paid course overall

E2 built its reputation on doing the unglamorous thing well: methods for each question type, live classes, and — on the higher tiers — human-marked essays and speaking assessments mapped to the band descriptors. That marking is the feature that justifies paying.

### Magoosh IELTS — best budget structured course

Short, clear video lessons, a large question bank, and ready-made study schedules at a genuinely low subscription price. What it lacks is live teaching and full human essay marking, so treat it as a structured spine for self-study rather than a complete solution.
...
strong value if your weakest skills are Reading and Listening; pair it with a separate feedback service for Writing.

### Udemy — cheapest, but check before you buy

Udemy hosts hundreds of IELTS courses of wildly uneven quality, usually sold at heavy discounts. A well-chosen one can efficiently patch a single gap — Task 1 process diagrams, say, or paraphrasing for Reading.
...

### IELTS Progress Check — best reality check

This is the official online practice test, marked by trained IELTS markers, returning an indicative band score with feedback. It costs money per attempt, so use it strategically: once to establish your true starting level, and once about two weeks before the real test.
...
the single best answer to "am I actually ready?" — far more honest than any course's internal quiz scores.

## What Is the Best Free Online IELTS Preparation?

The best free IELTS preparation online is a three-part stack: official materials from British Council (IELTS Ready) and IDP (IELTS Prepare) for accurate test-format practice, authentic Cambridge IELTS past papers for full timed mock tests, and an experienced teacher's free site such as IELTS Liz for technique.

Here is how the stack works in practice:

- Official sources for accuracy. IELTS Ready, IDP IELTS Prepare, and the free sample questions on ielts.org guarantee the question formats are current. Third-party "free practice tests" often drift from the real format.
- Cambridge books for mock tests. The series of authentic past papers now runs to Cambridge IELTS 21 as of mid-2026. These are the only widely available tests written by the people who write the real exam. Our guide to how many Cambridge IELTS books there are breaks down every volume and which to buy first — and if you want to sequence them by difficulty, see which Cambridge IELTS book is the hardest.
- Teacher sites for technique. Free sites run by veteran IELTS teachers explain question strategies the official materials present more drily. Read them for method; do not treat their unofficial practice questions as band-accurate.

The honest limitation: a fully free route gives you no human marking. You can reach Band 6.5–7.0 in Reading and Listening on free materials alone, because answer keys tell you the truth. Writing is where free-only candidates stall — you cannot see your own coherence problems, and the band descriptors are hard to apply to your own essay. Budget for feedback there first.

## Is Online IELTS Coaching Worth It?

Live online coaching is worth paying for in two situations: your mock-test band has not moved after two full study cycles, or your Writing and Speaking sit a band below your Reading and Listening. Outside those cases, recorded courses plus official free materials cover the same content for far less.

Criterion | E2 Language | IELTS Advantage

Winner:
...
E2 teaches Reading and Listening as first-class subjects: dedicated method lessons, live classes where you can ask about specific question types, and practice sets tied to the teaching.

IELTS Advantage covers both skills competently within its courses, but they are supporting modules around the Writing core rather than co-stars.

Neither offers high-volume practice with per-type analytics - both assume you will source practice material alongside the course.
...
## Speaking help: E2

E2's live speaking classes and human speaking assessments are the real thing: an experienced listener scoring your responses against the descriptors, plus scheduled classes that force regular speaking practice - the habit most self-studiers skip.

IELTS Advantage teaches Speaking well on paper - question banks, strategy, model answers - but with less live interaction in the standard offering.

Winner: E2, comfortably. A Speaking-weak candidate should not pick a Writing specialist to fix it.

## Pricing: depends on your gap, E2 for flexibility

E2's tiered packages let you size the purchase to your needs - a lower tier for method lessons, higher tiers for more assessment credits and one-on-one tutorials - from $69 for Express to $359 for Gold as of September 2026, with free sample classes to trial the format first.

IELTS Advantage concentrates its value into one flagship purchase, listed at $497 as of September 2026 (promotions vary). That is serious money, but it is a one-off rather than a subscription clock, includes one-on-one feedback sessions, and carries band-based guarantee terms.

Its free blog, meanwhile, is arguably the best zero-cost Writing resource after the official materials.

Winner: E2 on flexibility and entry price; IELTS Advantage defends its price best for candidates whose single blocker is Writing. Our breakdown of online prep vs coaching helps size how much human feedback you actually need.

## Progress tracking: a tie, and a low bar

Both platforms track course completion - lessons finished, assessments used - and both give you human judgments of your level at assessment points. Neither maintains a per-question-type band trend or analyses your practice mistakes automatically.

That is normal for teaching products: the teacher is the feedback loop. But between assessments, your daily practice generates data neither platform captures.

Winner: tie. The measurement layer has to come from elsewhere, which brings us to the third option.

## So which should you choose?

Choose E2 if your gaps span multiple skills, if Speaking is among them, or if you know a timetable and live teachers are what keep you working. It is the more complete school.

Choose IELTS Advantage if Writing - and only Writing - stands between you and your target band, and you want a correction-heavy program with expert eyes on your essays. Start with its free blog; if the teaching style lands, the paid course is more of what already works for you.

Either way, be honest about what you are buying: teaching and feedback moments, not practice volume or measurement. The candidates who get full value from either pair it with daily measured practice.

## Four questions to answer before paying either

First: what does your last real test or full mock say is your lowest skill? Not your least favourite - your lowest scored. If you have no recent score, get one before spending course money; both platforms will serve you better once you know your gap.

Second: will you actually attend scheduled classes? E2's live element is its price premium, and it only pays if you show up. Candidates who know they will watch recordings at midnight should not pay for a timetable.

Third: have you exhausted the free layer? IELTS Advantage's blog teaches a large share of its course concepts free; E2's free sample live classes show you the class format. Consuming those first either saves you the purchase or confirms it.

Fourth: what happens between feedback sessions? A weekly human mark is a checkpoint, not a practice regime. If your answer is "nothing measures my daily work", fix that before or alongside the course - it is the cheapest part of the stack and the one that compounds.

Answer all four honestly and the E2-versus-IELTS-Advantage decision usually collapses into an obvious choice - or reveals that what you needed first was not a course at all.

results.title: 花钱就能拿高分
results.summary:
# 花钱就能拿高分

# 代刷网课业务“入侵”高校

上学期期末考试的网络选修课挂科后，周平吸取了教训。这学期他通过一个QQ群联系上“刷课代理”，购买了“代学网课、代考试”的一条龙“刷课”服务，轻松拿到了这门课的成绩。

周平选的课程叫“敦煌艺术”，第一次只考了50分，第二个学期重修，花了10元“刷课”，结果考了98分。

在这里，和周平有同样需求的大学生，可以在QQ群里联系上“刷课代理”，只需要花一二十元钱，给对方提供在线课程的登录账号和密码，就能享受“代刷”的一条龙服务，从上课到考试全程不用管，就能轻松拿到高分。

## “刷课”产业链

每学期在线课程开课和结课期间，都是张林业务最忙的时候，有不少同学会在此时找他“刷课”。

作为武汉市某高校负责刷课平台的一级学生代理，张林告诉记者，伴随着在线课程在全国范围内推广，网课教学早已成为高校的“标配”。为了拿到校内刷课业务的“大头”，他注册了八九个刷课平台账号，“几乎可以覆盖市面上所有的刷课平台”。

这些刷课平台直通全国80%高校的不同在线课程平台：此外，针对少数监管较严的在线课程教育平台，有的刷课平台还会单独开发软件。

尽管大多数刷课广告打着“纯手工刷课”的名头，但张林透露，“不存在纯手工，太耗时了”。

他介绍，通常刷课平台是利用软件或网站把客户的账号和密码录人系统，让视频呈倍速播放。“安全”点的平台，会专门在一个机房里挂机，这样网课平台不容易发现异常，账号也不会被冻结。

刷课平台的运营者，会将刷课权限进行二次转卖。类似张林这样的一级代理凭借手中掌握的刷课平台权限，就能够将高校里的各大在线课程平台“一网打尽”。

刷课“旺季”来临时，张林和其他的代理们还会通过QQ群、QQ空间、微信朋友圈，主动进行“矩阵”式广告宣传。在他接到的刷课业务中，来自二本院校和高职高专学生较多，也有来自独立学院的学生。

“要人行，就得给上级代理送钱，让他们帮忙推荐刷课平台的开发者，并从他们手里拿到权限，这样给的成本价就特别低。”在张林接触到的刷课平台中，一级代理分三个档次：给刷课平台充值1000元、5000元、1万元。充值的金额越大，刷课的成本就越低，利润也越大，刷课的安全性越高，越不容易被在线课程教育平台发现。

往平台投人千把块钱之后，张林驾驭了这份轻松的兼职，成为多个平台的一级代理。他的成本价从去年每单0.6-0.7元降至今年的0.2-0.3元，而刷课单价依旧是10至15元。以学生身份担保“刷课信誉”的张林，总能赢得身边同学的信任。兼职“从业”一年多来，这名“资深刷客”在武汉市的高校内发展了40多个二级代理为他接单、刷课。

## 在线课程的尴尬现实

“很多网课是国内顶尖大学的知名教授的课堂录像，以前根本没有机会听到这些老师的课，这对于我们拓展学科视野有很大的帮助。”郑州大学2017级商学院工商管理专业李锦华说，学校对在线课程学习不作强制要求，但自己会根据兴趣学习一些课程，比如数字摄影、艺术史等。

在周平所就读的学校，2019年上半年，学校开放了近百门公共选修课，其中网络课程有81门。他表示，学校的培养方案中要求，本科生须修满6个公共选修课学分才能毕业。

尽管课程分值较大，有些必修课还与研保直接挂钩，但武汉一所985高校汉语言文学专业大二学生张正华坦言，自己和同学在学习网课时确实比较敷衍，“大家觉得学不到太多东西，毕竟一节课只有十来分钟”。

刘晓认为，网课学习有时收获不大，因为网络测试可以多个平台操作，很多...

results.title: 付费刷课灰色产业为何如此猖獗？
results.summary:
# 付费刷课灰色产业为何如此猖獗？

文/《北京青年报》记者温婧

# 付费代刷

# 产业链完整已形成市场定价

代刷网课，按副课手段的不同，主要分2种一一机刷和纯手工刷。

辽宁警方不久前侦破的利用刷客平台“付费刷课”案件，就属于机刷。据警方通报，5家刷课平台数据显示，仅2019年\~2020年，全国范围购买刷课服务的学生就超过790万人，刷课数量超过7900万科次，涉事刷课平台的下线代理人超过10万，其中大多数都是在校学生。

曾有媒体报道，机刷网课这一灰色产业的背后，已经形成了“刷课平台一一一级代理一二级代理”等形式的完整产业链：这些刷课平台直通全国 \(8 0 \%\) 高校的不同在线课程平台（以下简称“网课平台”），甚至针对少数监管比较严的网课平台，还会开发专门的刷课软件：到了接单“旺季”，各分级代理们会通过QQ群、QQ空间、微信朋友圈等渠道，主动进行“矩阵”式广告宣传。据说，在刷课“旺季”，一级代理日赚5000元不在话下，二级代理与自己的上级分红则是依接单数逐级而定。

不少同学担心机刷网课被查到的风险太大，都更倾向于找“纯手工刷课”，然而记者从养荷处了解到，不少打着“纯手工刷课”旗号接单的，实则都是机刷网课代理，“一个人才几个终端能同时刷课呢？单价便宜又走量的，肯定是机刷代理。”

与机刷代理不同，养荷说她有3台能上网课的终端，可以同时应付3个单子，能做到真实模拟上网课的操作，因此也更为隐蔽，从未被网课平台发现。每逢期末，总有大批同学积攒下一大堆没上的网课，养荷就看准了这个“商机”赚一些钱补贴日用。她一般是在刷课QQ群发布“纯手工代课”广告，有需要刷课的就会来私聊她，视待完成学时商量价格，一般五六十元一门课，包考试95分以上，“要付出2\~3天的时间精力，肯定比机刷更贵一些，不过胜在隐蔽，且考试分数和刷课质量高，两天赚一个星期的生活费还是没问题的。”

养荷坦言，机刷代理固然猖，但像她这样的个人纯手工接单刷课群体，才更为庞大、隐蔽，“就像藏在海面下的冰山”。她认为个人可能没有成为刷课代理的渠道，也不一定愿意冒着被学校处分的风险去赚代理钱，但“没人会拒绝顺手赚点零花钱”，据她观察，个人偶尔接单刷课的比代理人数多得多。

此外，记者还注意到，在某电商平台也很容易便能搜索和购买到代刷网课服务，甚至能轻松购买到刷网课的软件脚本。在一个刷课软件脚本的“详情”中写道：“这是一款在电脑上使用的代替人工手动操作，实现自动化的万能网课脚本，无论是什么网课都可以。”售价98元，不过该店客服表示，该脚本不支持答题或考试。

截至2020年年底，我国的慕课（简称“MOOC”，意为大规模开放网络课程）数量和应用规模已位居世界第一，上线慕课数量超过3.4万门，学习人数达5.4亿人次。

在网课繁荣的背后竞然隐藏着付费刷课灰色产业链。据警方通报，仅在2019年\~2020年，全国范围内购买刷课服务的学生就超过790万人，刷课数量逾7900万科次，涉事刷课平台的下线代理人超过10万，其中大多数都是在校学生。

南都记者在百度贴吧、QQ群均能找到大量网课代刷的内容。有部分下单网课代刷的网站，甚至还能提供包括淘宝、微信公众号、小红书、微博、B站等平台在内的买关注、买赞、买阅读量、买转发等服务，拼多多砍价、京东砍价、低价购买视频网站会员、找游戏代练也可以通过该平台下单。

# 揭秘留学生“代上网课”业务：枪手能替学生全程出镜

澎湃新闻 12-26 16:34

2020年12月初，网名为“Lucy_intheSkywithDiamonds”（以下称Lucy）的微博网友发博称，自己是国外高校授课教师，班上的学生在11月中旬因车祸去世后仍与多名任课老师有邮件往来，并完成了小测与期末的final paper（结课论文）。这令全院老师惊恐不已，随后才得知，该学生生前找了网课代管，枪手一直在替她完成课程作业。

新冠病毒在全球范围持续蔓延，不少国家也因此正常教学受影响，大多数的课程教学由线下变为线上。技术的便利虽使远程授课得以顺利进行，却难以保障屏幕后学生的出席率与课堂参与度。趁着疫情，代留学生上网课的产业悄然出现。

红星新闻记者调查发现，网课代上机构分为全包和半包两种模式，收费一千到上万不等，“只要把学校网站账号密码交给他们，就能保B争A”，甚至只要提供自己的形象照片，枪手就能代替学生全程出境。

Lucy称，此后其收到学校邮件，要协助调查，整理一份网课代管网站的名单，该网友才得知疫情期间这短短几个月，这种网课代管的产业链已经发展得极其完善。“一条龙服务，只要把学校网站账号密码交给他们，就能保B争A。”
...
红星新闻试图联系Lucy，但对方在微博表示，自己未开放私信，也不愿再就学生找人代上网课一事发表任何看法。

红星新闻记者在搜索引擎上检索“代上网课”，的确能找到不少代上网课的广告。广告里，大部分是自称“为海外留学生课业辅导”的教育科技公司。同时，在不少留学生交流群里也常常见到此类信息。

“代上网课”是由代写作业、代考试发展而来，即由个人或者机构代替学生完成网课相关的学习内容，除了写作业和考试，还包括打卡出勤、小组讨论等。

记者添加上四家网课代管机构的工作人员，对方称需要提供在读国家和学历、网课类型、网课名称、课程所需时间和所需的成绩等信息评估服务费用。对于代课枪手的背景信息，多名中介表示，自己聘请了海外知名高校的博士生，有一家官网公开显示，该公司的合作导师来自剑桥大学、宾夕法尼亚大学等多所名校。

一家叫AGXX的机构工作人员表示，他们的定价标准是依据学生对课程成绩要求。以美国院校在读本科生为例，若要求一门课的最终成绩为A，价格则是1750美元（约11466元人民币），若只是要求不挂科，价格则是1350美元（约8845元人民币），下单的网课数量越多，享受优惠越大，若课程难度大及作业量大，会额外增加200-500美元不等的费用。

对于枪手能否露脸上课，AGXX的工作人员表示，代课者为了保护自己的隐私都是不愿意露面的，如果需要的话，得另外加费。但该工作人员随后建议，为避免被任课老师发现，还是由学生自己出席直播课较好。

学校：大课一般不开摄像头 小课会有出镜要求

实际上，很多国家学校的网课并未强行要求学生上课时开启摄像头，多名在欧美留学的受访者向红星新闻记者证实这一点。

英国诺丁汉大学电气电子工程的陈同学表示，自己第一学期的大部分课程都是录播课，很少有直播课，就算有，大部分同学是“闭麦加关摄像头。”

芝加哥大学哈里斯公共政策专业就读的单同学称，她的专业课老师要求更为宽松，“不去上课都可以，因为教授们的理念是，在这个特殊时期，需要多多体谅彼此。”

不用在课堂上露脸，也意味着授课老师对学生的状态更难以把控。在牛津大学学习日本研究的S同学告诉红星新闻记者，自己大部分课程都是线上授课，而上课时自己从不开摄像头，“因为我摄像头在屏幕下面，我的确不专心，好多课都是躺着上的。”

# GitHub - TheMythologist/GenP: Automatically builds GenP executables from source · GitHub

# GenP — Adobe CC Universal Patcher (Open Source)

> **This repository is strictly for educational and archival purposes only.**

GenP (Generic Patcher) is an open-source Adobe patcher written in AutoIt that applies binary hex patches to Adobe Creative Cloud application files, modifying their licensing behavior. It supports Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro, After Effects, Acrobat, Lightroom, and the rest of the CC suite on Windows 10 and 11.

Copies of GenP float around on Discord, Telegram, and random file hosts — and there's no way to tell if those binaries are clean or packed with malware. That's the problem this repo fixes:

  * **Source code is public.** The AutoIt source and all patch definitions (`config.ini`) are right here. Read them before you run anything.
  * **Builds happen on GitHub Actions, not someone's PC.** The CI workflow (`.github/workflows/release.yml`) runs on GitHub-hosted runners. No one touches the binary between compilation and upload.
  * **Releases ship with SHA checksums.** You can verify that what you downloaded matches what CI produced, byte for byte.

If your copy didn't come from this repo's GitHub Releases page, you can't know what's in it.

## Origins

  * **Original project:** gen.paramore.su
  * **Community continuation & guides:** wiki.dbzer0.com/genp-guides

## History of GenP and Adobe

### Adobe Kills Perpetual Licenses (2013)

In 2013, Adobe dropped perpetual licenses for Creative Suite and went all-in on the Creative Cloud subscription model. A lot of people hated it. Surveys at the time put the number at 87% of users preferring the old model. For hobbyists, students, and freelancers who couldn't justify the recurring cost, piracy tools became the workaround.

### GenP Shows Up (~2019)

GenP first appeared around 2019. A developer going by **Uncia** built it as a universal Adobe CC patcher — one tool that could patch Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere, and the rest of the suite in one shot. It worked by applying hex patches to application binaries, disabling the Adobe Genuine Service (AGS), licensing checks, and phone-home calls.

The **r/GenP** subreddit quickly became the main hub for downloads, guides, and troubleshooting.

### Version History

Version | When | What Changed  
---|---|---  
2.0 | ~2019 | First multi-app patcher for Adobe CC 2019  
2.4–2.5 | 2020 | Stability fixes, CC 2019–2020 compat  
2.7 | 2021–2022 | Partial Acrobat support  
3.0 | ~2023 | Hosts file bypass, full Acrobat support — Uncia's last release  
3.4+ | 2024 | Taken over by the CGP community  
3.7.x | 2025 | Latest Adobe versions, Windows 10/11  

### Uncia Steps Down, CGP Takes Over

Uncia retired from the scene in early 2023 and dropped GenP 3.0.3 (listed on Reddit as GenP 3.0) with the full source code. The **CGP (Community GenP)** group picked it up from there, keeping it working against newer Adobe releases. The credits in current versions read: _"Original version by Uncia — CGP + GenP Community Edition."_

### How Adobe Fought Back

Adobe didn't just sit and watch. Their response came in waves:

  * **Adobe Genuine Service (AGS)** — a background process that flags modified installs and nags users with "non-genuine software" warnings.
  * **Anti-crack updates (2022)** — Adobe CC version 23.x shipped with detection code specifically targeting GenP patches, breaking older versions of the tool overnight.
  * **DMCA takedowns (2025)** — Adobe went after hosting platforms and communities distributing GenP with formal DMCA notices.
  * **Selective enforcement** — Adobe doesn't brick every patched install. They use a mix of warnings, feature degradation, and targeted lockouts. Casual users mostly get left alone (they stay in the Adobe ecosystem), while commercial use gets cracked...

...
# Photoshop/Premiere Pro/After Effects Unlocker

 **Download latest version** (v1.03):
...
If you don't trust my build, you can build it yourself, source code is in repository. No additional libraries required.

## Description

Unlicenced or sometimes offline Adobe apps are strive to interrupt your work with annoying popup messages. This counts following messages:  

  1. Unlicenced copy warning
  2. Unskipable warning when Photoshop cannot access internet
  3. Forced licence accept window. You have no option to decline the licence and continue working.

It supports: Photoshop, Premiere Pro, After Effects 

This tool is created ~~to fuck Adobe~~ to give you more freedom and allow to use Photoshop/Premiere Pro or AfterEffects without stupid restrictions (like offline mode) or accepting licence terms when it forces you to do that. This program is realtime monitoring software to detect annouying popup windows in Photoshop. When such windows appers it instantly closes this window, unlocks Photoshop main window and makes it focused, so you can keep working without being interrupted.

# How to use

This is not neccessary, but if you don't need cloud features and want to force the Photoshop to work in offline mode I recommend you to block Adobe hosts by adding them into your Windows **hosts** file.   
You should do it manually, psunlock does not mess with your system files.   
List of Adobe hosts can be found here: https://github.com/Ruddernation-Designs/Adobe-URL-Block-List/blob/master/hosts   
This will force Adobe apps to run in offline mode.

## Method A (Recommended)

  1. Put **psunlock.exe** into your Photoshop/Premiere or AE folder
  2. Create a desktop shortcut for **psunlock.exe**
  3. Instead of launching adobe app you should launch the shortcut of PSUnlock. PSUnlock automatically runs Photoshop/Premiere/AE. So you can use it as a launcher. And it runs only one instance of unlock process even if you running multiple apps. It is programmed to simultaneously monitor PS/Premiere/AE for annoying popups.

## Method B

  1. Run **psunlock.exe** from any folder.
  2. Run Adobe app (Different apps at once supported). (You can launch **psunlock.exe** after any Adobe app that is supported by this unlocker)

# How it works?

  * When PSUnlock starts, it runs as a background process.
  * While running, you'll see its icon in the system tray.
  * It instantly detects a running instance of Photoshop/Premiere/AE and begins monitoring for blocking popup windows.
  * If non of Adobe apps are running, it will wait until you launch it.
  * Double-clicking the tray icon will always bring the Adobe app windows to the foreground (a quality-of-life feature).
  * Right-clicking the icon opens a context menu, where you be able to stop and exit PS Unlock (If you really want to for some reason).
  * All blocking popup warnings are closed instantly. The Photoshop window becomes responsive, allowing you to continue your work without interruption.
  * PSUnlock stops working right after you quit all Adobe apps.

...
After one too many Netflix price hikes and evenings disappointed by the lack of fresh content, I decided enough was enough, and it was time to seek an alternative. To my surprise, I discovered a wealth of free, legal, high-quality apps offering movies, TV shows, and even live TV channels that I didn't realize I was missing. Some of these services were so good that they made it especially easy to cut ties with my subscribed streaming platforms.

## 1 Plex

### Stream for free and manage your own media

I am relatively new to Plex, but it has quickly become an essential part of my home entertainment setup. If you are a movie lover or a home media tinkerer, it's well worth setting up a private media server to organize your collection. I started down this route, but Plex has now evolved into a fully-fledged free streaming service as well.

Plex offers thousands of on-demand movies and TV episodes, as well as an impressive live TV service that offers more than 300 channels. These include everything from news and sports to retro shows and cult films. It can be downloaded onto many devices, from smart TVs to game consoles, or used with a TV streaming stick. If you're looking to cut down on the number of apps you use, this dual-purpose solution, which combines your home media with free streaming, is hard to beat.

### A Titan among free streaming services

Tubi should be on the radar of anyone looking to break from paid TV subscriptions. It boasts a massive collection of over 50,000 titles, from Hollywood blockbusters to cult classics, favorite TV series, and even anime and niche genres. I like it for its refreshingly simple interface and overall decent image quality, with many newer titles in HD.

As with most free streaming platforms, the only drawback is sitting through ad breaks, but these are shorter and less intrusive than the TV commercials that I remember. On the positive side, there is an incredible variety—from Oscar-winning dramas to old-school sitcoms—and the element of surprise when I come across something I was hoping to see or that offers a welcome dose of nostalgia. results.title: WikiFlix goes live
results.summary:
### WikiFlix goes live

May 2, 2025

WikiFlix, a new free streaming platform developed by Wikimedia Germany, the parent company of Wikidata, has gone live.

The service gives users access to a library of freely licensed films and aims to provide an alternative to commercial streaming giants, while complementing public broadcaster media libraries. Some of the titles available include 20,000 Leagues Under the Sea (1916), Scarface (1932), Nosferatu (1922) and It’s a Wonderful Life (1946).

WikiFlix requires no login or registration, allowing users to dive straight into its catalogue spanning action, westerns, comedies and documentaries. While many of the 2,500+ films are in English, viewers can also enjoy content in French, Danish, Russian, and Japanese.

The idea for WikiFlix and its name originally came from the Wikipedian ‘Spinster’, aka Sandra Fauconnier, who inspired fellow WikiMedian, Magnus Manske, to develop the free streaming service using Wikidata to ensure WikiFlix showcased the latest films.
...
WikiFlix doesn’t host the content itself. Instead, it uses linked data from Wikidata to access public domain content on the Internet Archive, Wikimedia Commons, and YouTube.

“WikiFlix democratises access to film, offering a rich and varied selection without the constraints of paywalls or subscriptions,” explained Lydia Pintscher, Portfolio Lead Product Manager, Wikidata. “We believe in the power of open access, and this platform embodies that ethos. You don’t need any registration, login credentials or wiki knowledge to use WikiFlix. Anyone can search for and watch films. Users can explore cinematic treasures from around the world, completely free of charge.”

The service also features more recent open-source productions, such as the 2008 animated short Big Buck Bunny, created using Blender, a free 3D animation software. WikiFlix provides detailed information about each film, including its production history and licensing details.

results.summary:
It’s nice to remember that not everything on the internet needs to be a subscription-based platform with ads. On WikiFlix, a Netflix-inspired archive of public domain films, you can watch movies like “It’s a Wonderful Life” and “Nosferatu” for free. You don’t even have to make an account!
...
A project of Wikipedia’s volunteer community, WikiFlix hosts over 4,000 movies from Wikimedia Commons, the Internet Archive, or YouTube that have fallen into the public domain — that means they are free to share and distribute, usually because the copyright lapsed, or there was never any copyright at all. So, yes, most of the movies on the WikiFlix homepage are your grandma’s age, but isn’t it kind of fun to imagine what Netflix would’ve been like back in the day?

WikiFlix isn’t new, but it’s new to us, courtesy of a TikTok by Annie Rauwerda, the creator behind the “Depths of Wikipedia” accounts.

While WikiFlix can introduce you to historic films like “Wings,” the first movie to win the Academy Award for Best Picture, there’s also a bunch of hidden gems on there. As Rauwerda says in her TikTok, “Sometimes I really like watching things that I know nobody else is watching, because what if I discover something crazy?”

On its homepage, WikiFlix prioritizes movies that have a lot of sitelinks on their Wikipedia pages, since those are more likely to be popular or interesting. But there is some degree of curation. The community around WikiFlix maintains a blacklist, which helps ensure that you’re not going to run into a historical Nazi propaganda film during your next “WikiFlix and chill” night. (“While these [films] are perfectly fine in an educational context, WikiFlix is more focused on entertainment,” a WikiFlix page says.)

WikiFlix content may not exactly be as binge-worthy as “Stranger Things,” but give it a try. Why not watch a Soviet musical inspired by Cinderella, a silent film about swashbuckling pirates, or a Japanese post-apocalyptic film that features a guy who somehow played for both the Boston Celtics and the Chicago Cubs? You can always catch up on “Love Is Blind” another time.

# WikiFlix Free Public Domain Movies Archive Inspired by Netflix

Wednesday, 17 December 2025, 00:33

WikiFlix is an archival online service inspired by Netflix’s style, but focused on public-domain films available to watch for free.

Users here don’t need a subscription or an account. Most materials come from the public domain and are gathered from Wikimedia Commons, Internet Archive, or YouTube, which allows them to be legally distributed for free viewing.

Although most titles have aged, the concept is intriguing: what would a Netflix-style library look like if it were set a hundred years ago?

## What you should know about WikiFlix and its approach

WikiFlix isn’t a new service, but it became an interesting discovery thanks to a TikTok video by Ani Rauverdi, the creator of the “Depths of Wikipedia” accounts.

While the platform does host historical films, including Wings – the first Best Picture winner – the service also offers a lot of diverse content. In her videos Rauverda shares: “Sometimes I really like watching things that no one else watches, because what if I discover something incredible?”

“While these films are perfectly suitable for an educational context, WikiFlix is more focused on entertainment”

On WikiFlix’s homepage the focus is on films with numerous external links to their Wikipedia pages, which usually indicates popularity or audience interest. At the same time there is a certain curation: the community maintains a blacklist to avoid historically propagandistic materials during the next “WikiFlix and chill”.

The content of WikiFlix may not offer the same level of “binge-worthiness” as modern series like Stranger Things, but it is worth checking out. Here you can come across a Soviet musical film based on Cinderella, a silent film about brave pirates, and a Japanese post-apocalyptic film featuring a hero who allegedly supported both sides – the Boston Celtics and the Chicago Cubs. ## Boostero Categories and Features

### Social Media Management Software

Boostero is not designed as a scheduling or publishing solution. It does not handle content posting, calendar management, or brand monitoring, and it is not meant to replace platforms like Hootsuite, Buffer, or Later. Instead, it focuses on enhancing the paid engagement aspect of social media strategies by providing followers, likes, views, comments, shares, and saves across more than 23 platforms. These services can be ordered individually or accessed via an API, with clear terms for each service presented before checkout and tracking available post-order. Agencies and resellers typically use Boostero in conjunction with a scheduling tool rather than as a substitute. The scheduling tool determines the timing of content releases, while Boostero generates the initial engagement signals needed for the content to be distributed effectively. The engagement that is purchased acts as a signal type, while the platform takes care of the subsequent processes. Since its establishment in 2020, Boostero has offered over 1,600 services and has garnered a user base of 211,000 across more than 125 countries.

### SMM Panels

Boostero is a specialized SMM panel designed specifically for repeat customers and resellers, rather than for individual transactions. It boasts an extensive selection of 1,600 services across more than 23 platforms, all accessible from a centralized dashboard. Here, users can easily view the cost per 1,000 units, along with the minimum and maximum order limits, refill conditions, and average delivery times derived from completed transactions—all before making a payment. To place an order, users need only a public link or username; no passwords are required. The ordering process utilizes a well-documented REST API that includes ten different calls to manage the entire workflow: from services and adding orders to checking the status for up to 100 order IDs simultaneously, handling refills, monitoring refill status, cancellations, and balance inquiries. Instead of relying on webhook callbacks, status updates are acquired through polling. Agencies can also take advantage of white-label child panels to market services under their own brand identity. Established in 2020 and based in Delaware, Boostero has successfully completed 12 million orders for 211,000 registered users across over 125 countries.

# Най-добрите сайтове за закупуване на последователи в Instagram през 2026 г.

- Felix Rose-Collins •

## Въведение

Отворете достатъчно от тези страници за плащане наведнъж и ще започнете да забелязвате някои неща. Twicsy продава 100 последователи в Instagram за 3,49 долара. Buzzoid продава 100 за 3,49 долара. iDigic продава 100 за 3,49 долара. Не приблизително. Същите три долара и четиридесет и девет цента при три марки, които се представят като конкуренти.

Преминете на по-високо ниво и същото се повтаря. iDigic иска 14,99 долара за 1 000. TokMatik иска 14,99 долара за 1 000. Четири от тези сайтове класифицират последователите в същите три нива с почти еднакви наименования: „високо качество“ в долната част, „активни“ или „премиум“ в средата, „VIP“ в горната част.

Това не е конспирация. Така изглежда пазарът, когато витрините са отделни, а предлагането зад тях в по-голямата си част не е. Което тихо променя въпроса. Вие не избирате източник на последователи. Избирате магазин, а магазините винаги са се различавали по свой собствен начин: какво пише на етикета с цената, какво ще посочат писмено и кой отговаря, когато нещо се обърка.

Ето теста, който проведох върху всички тях. Можете ли да видите реалната сума в долари, преди да стигнете до екрана за плащане?

## 1. FastSocial показва сумата

Тук можете да си купите последователи в Instagram и да знаете колко плащате, преди да се ангажирате с каквото и да било, защото цялата ценова скала е публикувана в долари. 3 долара за 100. 12 долара за 1 000. 30 долара за 5 000. 45 долара за 10 000. 90 долара за 25 000. 170 долара за 50 000. 330 долара за 100 000.

Това изглежда като ниска летва. Отделете един следобед на това проучване и ще видите колко малко сайтове я преминават. Стандартният ход е вместо това да ви покажат процент – 58% отстъпка на едно ниво и 78% отстъпка на друго, което не ви казва абсолютно нищо, докато не разберете 58% отстъпка от какво. Отстъпка, изчислена спрямо число, измислено от продавача, е просто етикет.

# How Much Do Instagram Followers Cost in 2026? The Transparent Pricing Guide Nobody Publishes

Published: July 13, 2026 | Category: Instagram Growth, Pricing | Read Time: 8 min | Author: IndianSMMServices.com Team

Quick answer: In 2026, 1,000 Instagram followers cost anywhere from under ₹100 (about a dollar) for bot-tier accounts to a few hundred rupees for high-quality profiles with refill guarantees, up to several times that for real-user followers — a 5–10x spread that is entirely explained by quality tier. The same services cost 3–10x more on retail "buy followers" websites, because most of those sites fulfill orders through wholesale SMM panels and pocket the markup. The price you should pay depends on one question: will anyone inspect your follower list? If yes, buy quality tiers. If you are comparing providers, compare tier-for-tier — a cheap price on the wrong tier is the most expensive purchase in this market.

Most providers keep pricing vague until checkout. After 1,000,000+ orders since 2019, we would rather publish the honest structure of the market — including the parts that explain why our own catalog shows prices upfront.

## The 2026 Price Map, Tier by Tier

Every follower service in the world falls into the three tiers we anatomized in our real vs HQ vs bot guide, and price follows tier with near-perfect consistency:

- Bot tier — the floor: mass-created empty accounts, often priced under ₹100 per thousand at wholesale. Instant delivery, heavy drops, usually no refill. You are paying for a number, and the price honestly reflects that.
- High-quality (HQ) tier — the value zone: complete-looking profiles with photos and posts, typically a few hundred rupees per thousand with 30-day or longer refill windows. This is where roughly 80% of smart money goes — the credibility-per-rupee sweet spot for creators, businesses, and the local business playbook.
- Real tier — the ceiling: genuine users from promotion networks, priced several times HQ rates, delivered gradually, with the strongest retention and the only engagement potential. The tier for brand-deal influencers and anyone facing sponsor scrutiny.
- Targeting premium: country-specific followers — Indian, US, UK audiences — cost meaningfully more than worldwide mixes at every tier, because targeted delivery networks are smaller. Worth it when your buyers are local; wasted when only the count matters.

Exact live rates change with market conditions, which is why serious buyers check the per-service pricing on the services list — every service shows its rate, tier description, speed, and refill terms before payment, not after.

## The Markup Nobody Mentions: Panel vs Retail Websites

Search "buy Instagram followers" and the polished websites in the ads charge many times wholesale rates. Here is the industry's open secret: most retail follower sites are resellers fulfilling orders through wholesale panels — often through APIs exactly like the one in our automation guide. The product is identical; the markup pays for their Google Ads. Buying from a cheapest SMM panel directly is simply buying at the wholesale layer — the same reason smart shoppers buy from the mandi, not the mall. (And if you are on the other side of that trade, the reseller margin is precisely the business model our SMM reseller panel program exists for.)

## Red-Flag Pricing: When Cheap and Expensive Both Scam You

- Too cheap for the claim: "10,000 real active followers for ₹99" is a tier lie — real-tier quality cannot exist at bot-tier prices, economically. You will receive bots labeled as real. The tier test from our trust checklist catches this instantly.
- Too expensive for the tier: retail sites charging premium rates for what their descriptions quietly reveal is HQ or bot tier — the markup trap above. Compare tier-for-tier, never price-for-price.
- "Free" pricing: the most expensive tier of all, paid in passwords and spam actions — fully anatomized in our free followers exposé.
- Prices hidden until signup + deposit: transparent operators show rates publicly. Hidden pricing exists to trap deposited balances.

## The Comparison Buyers Actually Need: Followers vs Ads vs Agencies

For the specific job of building follower count and social proof, the cost gap is dramatic: follower-growth ad campaigns commonly work out to many times panel rates per follower gained, and social media agencies bundle the same panel-fulfilled growth inside monthly retainers costing more than a year of direct panel spend — the full math lives in our ads vs SMM panel breakdown...

# Leofame Followers: How the Service Works, Pricing, and What to Check First

Leofame followers refers to the Instagram and TikTok follower packages sold by Leofame, alongside a limited free daily trial.

The service adds followers to a connected account without requiring a password. What that actually means for account safety and follower quality is worth breaking down before signing up.

## What Is Leofame Followers

Leofame is a social media growth service. Its core offering is straightforward: pick a platform, choose a follower quantity, and pay a one-time fee. No subscription is required for the base packages.

### What the Service Offers

The service covers followers, likes, views, saves, and shares but "leofame followers" specifically refers to the follower packages for Instagram and TikTok.

In practice, most users land on this service while comparing options for a quick follower boost rather than a long-term growth strategy.

### Platforms Supported

Leofame currently supports Instagram and TikTok. Instagram has the broader set of tools followers, likes, views, saves, shares, and story views while TikTok is limited to followers, likes, and views.

## Free Followers Trial

Before paying for anything, Leofame offers a free trial. It's small, and it resets daily, but it exists.

### How Many Free Followers Are Offered

According to the service, Instagram accounts receive 5 free followers per 24 hours, and TikTok accounts receive 10.

These numbers are stated directly on the site not independently verified by a third party, but they're the confirmed figures Leofame itself publishes.

### Requirements to Use the Free Trial

The account has to be public. That's the one hard requirement listed. No password, no card, no personal details at least according to Leofame's own terms for the trial.

## Paid Follower Packages

Once the free trial isn't enough, the paid tiers kick in.

### Starting Price

Instagram follower packages start at $2.85, billed as a one-time payment rather than a subscription.

Pricing scales up from there depending on the quantity selected, though exact tier pricing beyond the entry point isn't broken out publicly in a way that can be confirmed here.

### How Ordering Works

The process runs in three steps: select a package, enter the account username (no password needed), and wait for delivery. Payment is processed before the order is fulfilled.

### Refill Policy

Leofame states that refills are included within 30 days of purchase if follower counts drop. This is a claim made by the service, not something that can be externally confirmed for every order.

A handful of features come up repeatedly across the service's own marketing. Worth separating what's a stated policy from what's a subjective quality claim.

Leofame describes delivery as "instant" or starting immediately after payment. Actual delivery speed can vary by order size and platform load, which the site doesn't quantify in detail.

### No Password Requirement

This one's consistent across every package: no password is requested at any point. That's a fairly standard practice among follower services generally, not something unique to Leofame.

### Customer Support Availability

24/7 support is listed as a feature. In practice, response quality and speed for this kind of support tend to vary a lot between providers, and that's not something an outside source can verify from the site alone.

## Risks and Considerations Before Buying Followers

This is the part most follower-service pages gloss over. It shouldn't be skipped.

### Platform Terms of Service Conflicts

Instagram and TikTok both prohibit inorganic engagement, including purchased followers, under their platform policies. Enforcement is inconsistent some accounts see no action, others face reduced reach or, less commonly, restrictions.

As reported by CNBC, this risk isn't limited to platform policy either the U.S. Federal Trade Commission's 2024 rule also prohibits paying to inflate follower counts for commercial purposes, adding a regulatory layer on top of platform enforcement.

This risk applies to any follower-buying service, not just Leofame specifically.

### Authenticity and Engagement Quality

"Real followers" is a term used loosely across this industry. In practice, purchased followers frequently show low or no engagement they inflate the follower count without necessarily interacting with content.
